<mxfile host="drawio" version="24.7.17"> <diagram id="core-pipeline-lifecycle" name="SkyulfPipeline lifecycle"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="1140" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="1140" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" value="SkyulfPipeline: from a config dict to predictions" style="text;html=0;fontSize=20;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1A1A19;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="0" width="900" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_cfg" value="Config dict
preprocessing: list of steps
modeling: model type + params" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="50" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_init" value="1. SkyulfPipeline(config)
checks the config shape;
looks up the model type in the node registry" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="50" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_data" value="Training data
pandas or polars DataFrame,
or a ready SplitDataset" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="180" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_fit" value="2. pipeline.fit(data, target_column)
leakage check first: steps that learn
from data must come after the train/test split" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="180" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f_leak" value="ValueError
(on_leakage="raise" is the default);
nothing is fitted" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="180" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_split" value="3. Split step (TrainTestSplitter)
train / test / optional validation rows;
skipped when the data is already a SplitDataset" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="310" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_steps" value="4. Each preprocessing step, in order
Calculator learns params from the train rows;
Applier reuses those params on train, test
and validation rows (resampling: train only)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="440" width="420" height="96" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f_fail" value="A failed step or model
fit clears the fitted
steps and the model; call
fit() again to predict" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="448" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_model" value="5. Model
fit on the transformed train rows" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="586" width="420" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o_metrics" value="fit() returns metrics
per preprocessing step, and
model scores per split
(train / test / validation)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="578" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s_file" value="6. pipeline.save(path)
one pickle file holding the fitted pipeline" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="700" width="420" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_load" value="7. same feature columns,
